facts.value: An eight-byte .sdata2 literal pool holding big-endian f32 0.0F then 1.0F, bytes 000000003f800000 in both existing objects. Split-object flags are SHF_ALLOC; source-object flags are SHF_ALLOC|SHF_WRITE. Reviewed callbacks load the literals without writing this pool.
facts.rationale: Separate literal load behavior from differing ELF section permissions.

facts.value: Forwards the Dash object to ft_800844EC. Its query synchronizes CollData position, calls mpColl_8004B108, copies resolved position back and converts the result to GroundOrAir. The dispatcher tests that enum as a boolean: nonzero invokes the StopWall test using facing, wall flags, gr_vel and walk_max_vel; zero invokes ftCo_Fall_Enter. Physical ground/air interpretation is deferred because the enum conversion conflicts with inherited descriptions.
facts.rationale: Preserve exact query-result dispatch; inherited ground/air narrative is not established by this dependency contract.

facts.value: A nonzero ft_80082708 result leads to a StopWall check: facing must match the contacted wall flag and ABS(gr_vel) must exceed walk_max_vel. A zero result invokes ftCo_Fall_Enter. At this revision ft_80082708 returns GA_Air=1 for a true underlying map result and GA_Ground=0 for false; these labels conflict with the inherited gameplay interpretation and remain a family followup.
facts.rationale: Exact enum and boolean branches contradict inherited ground/air labels; do not infer a source fix.

facts.value: Enters and initializes Dash: clears command variable 0, starts the Dash motion, resets the horizontal-stick tilt timer, computes a facing-relative velocity correction, queues it through the common secondary-ground-acceleration helper, stores the integer mode flag, and conditionally plays the Dash sound. The helper may scale the correction by ground friction; this entry does not directly replace gr_vel.
facts.rationale: Entry queues acceleration rather than immediately installing velocity.

facts.value: A sufficiently recent and strong horizontal-stick tilt dispatches Dash when aligned with facing and smash Turn otherwise. Entry initializes motion variables and queues a facing-relative velocity correction in secondary ground acceleration, optionally scaled by ground friction. Callbacks provide frame-window interrupts, animation-expiry dispatch, ground movement and delegated map collision.
facts.rationale: Correct immediate facing-scaled velocity assignment to a queued, optionally scaled correction.
